description: This file contains test cases for error logging in a language model API interface, specifically testing logging of success/failure scenarios and various models or endpoints. It also verifies logging during streaming and embedding API calls.

methods.name: test_logging_success_completion
methods.description: Tests error logging for a successful completion call using a GPT-3.5 model, verifying that specific log messages are present in stdout during the call.

methods.name: test_logging_success_streaming_openai
methods.description: Tests error logging during a streaming completion call with an OpenAI model, checking for the presence of specific log messages and streaming response logs.

methods.name: test_logging_success_embedding_openai
methods.description: Tests error logging for an embedding API call with OpenAI, verifying that logging messages appear as expected.
